statement: A sign with fewer than 25 Sarvashtakavarga Bindus (the combined score across all seven planets) is considered a generally weaker area of the chart — matters tied to that sign tend to move with more friction and require more sustained effort.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
